name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
description: A hip hinge with a barbell held in front of your thighs: push your hips back with soft knees until you feel the hamstrings stretch, then stand up.
setup: Stand with feet hip-width apart, the barbell held at your thighs, hands just outside your legs.
cues: Push your hips back, knees soft.
Keep the bar close to your legs.

prescription.note: Pick a weight you can lift for every rep with good form. Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Stand tall
keyframes.cue: Bar in front of your thighs.

keyframes.name: Hinge
keyframes.cue: Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs.
